notes.title: Devlog #3: 2024 Update and the Future of Reborn a Zombie
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801201/99086fff497ad6f4e56e5adf2af6e00d6cb47dcc.png[/img]

A lot has changed in my life in 2024, but I’m happy to say things have been improving. Now, let’s dive into the news:

[h1]Reborn a Zombie: Major Update[/h1]
[b]When?[/b]
First half of 2025

[b]What’s new?[/b]
[list]
[*] The game will be playable in French.
[*] Added game controller support.
[*] A post-credits teaser that will tie into Reborn a Zombie 2.
[/list]
I personally handled the translation, and while it was a lot of work, it was also a lot of fun. I hope this will allow more people to enjoy the story.

[b]Reborn a Zombie 2 is also expected to receive a French translation.[/b]

[h1]Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts is Progressing, but There’s Still Much to Do[/h1]
[b]When?[/b]
Tentatively 2026

[b]Why the delay?[/b]
Depression.
I have a full-time job that demands a lot from me, and this passion project demands even more.

That said, I’m considering running a playtest to gather feedback on the first half of Reborn a Zombie 2. If you’re interested, join our Discord!

[h1]The Future of Reborn a Zombie and Asminae Games: Magii Archives[/h1]
Initially, I planned to announce future games following Reborn a Zombie 2. However, the time required to create each game has made me cautious. What’s the point of announcing games if they might not be delivered?

That said, here’s what I can share:

[b]Reborn a Zombie is part of Magii Archives[/b], a shared universe encompassing all my future games. Think of it as a mix between the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Terry Pratchett’s Discworld in terms of continuity and shared universe.

[b]Each new entry will stand alone[/b] but contribute to expanding this universe. Some will progress an overarching narrative, while others will explore fascinating aspects of this world.

[b]Reborn a Zombie is the first series in this universe.[/b]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Can I play games in any order I want?[/b]
Unless a game is a direct sequel, [b]each story is designed to be enjoyable as a standalone[/b]. However, playing other games in the Magii Archives will add depth to the experience, as the lore and major events will have repercussion across multiple entries.

[b]Are all Magii Archives games going to be kinetic, slice-of-life visual novels?[/b]
Not always. While the focus is on storytelling, I’m open to experimenting with gameplay styles.

[b]Are all Magii Archives games going to be trans-themed?[/b]
Reborn a Zombie was born out of my desire to share my experience as a trans person through storytelling. But writing is my passion, and I’m excited to explore a wide range of ideas and experiences in this universe.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
I won’t announce a game until its script is 100% complete. This ensures I can deliver high-quality stories and avoid making false promises.

One such project was Lamia Panic. Although the script was completed in March 2023, its flaws outweighed its strengths. I decided it was best used for worldbuilding instead of a standalone release.

That said, Reborn a Zombie 3 is very likely to happen. No promises yet, but it’s high on my list.

[h1]I Want More![/h1]
Thank you for your support! The best way to stay updated is through my Discord server. There, you’ll find news on current projects and the Magii Archives universe.

I’m so excited to share these stories with you. I’ve worked in the game industry for five years. Yet, Reborn a Zombie 2 is my most ambitious project, and I’m incredibly proud of it. I hope you’ll enjoy the story as much as I’ve enjoyed creating it.

– Asminae and the Asminae Games Team

notes.title: Announcing Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that [b]Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts is now officially in development![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43903920/42bb3ad683616f9864ec3000570073ede609d3ff.jpg[/img]
[i]Gorgeous artwork made by Betto, you can find their [url=https://twitter.com/BetrunkenH/status/1730548976649228559]twitter here[/url][/i]

Reborn a Zombie 2 is a direct sequel, set a couple of months after Dawn's transformation, and will heavily emphasize Lucia's family.

[b]You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2641800/Reborn_a_Zombie_2_Entwined_Hearts/]wishlist the game and get notified when it releases![/url][/b]

[b]Major feature includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]-About 40k words (3-4 hours of playtime)
[*]A story that explores Vulcan's past and expands on the world of Reborn a Zombie.
[*] A lot of demons, dragons, zombies, and also vampires?!
[/list]
[b]FAQ[/b]
[i]Do I need to play the first game?[/i]
[b]Yes.[/b] The good news is, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283350/Reborn_A_Zombie/]Reborn a Zombie is free![/url][/b]

[i]The CG above looks different. Will there be a shift in the game's art style?[/i]
If you're wondering why Dawn looks so different in the CG, you'll have to play the game!

[i]When will the game be released?[/i]
We hope to deliver the game in early 2025.

We will make more announcements down the road!
Thank you all for making this journey possible.
